title: plan-doc
description: A multi-step plan. Every step MUST declare its rollback (compensating action, SDS-C-045) even in a Query Skill's plan-doc output — the plan is what a later Command Skill will execute, and the compensating action must be decided at planning time, not improvised at execution time.

rollback.description: The compensating action for this step (SDS-C-045). If none exists, this MUST say so explicitly, and the step must be sequenced last.

checkpointAfter.description: Whether a resumable checkpoint is persisted after this step (SDS-S-053).
